name: extension
title: Suite B — browser extension autofill
description: A real Chromium-family browser, the real unpacked extension, the real kagisecure-nmhost launched by the browser, a real socket, and the real origin rule. Every state is screenshotted.
note: An MV3 extension does not load in a headless Chromium, so this suite needs a real login session with a window server and is local-only. There is no CI (removed 2026-09-19); the headless subset SUITE=mcp,cli is run locally instead. Chrome 137+ removed --load-extension, so the automated browser is Microsoft Edge; Safari cannot be driven by automation at all and its scenarios are reported as skipped with the manual steps printed.
